topics.title: Fred’s Absurd Phone Call
topics.summary: A radio host is repeatedly harassed by callers attempting to confuse and frustrate him with bizarre questions about Iraqi women, Captain Kangaroo, machine gunning Barney, and ultimately revealing the prank is orchestrated by multiple people trying to disrupt his show.

topics.title: Farting, Heatwaves, Scandalous Revelations
topics.summary: During the broadcast, callers discuss attempting to fart on television while complaining about extreme summer heat and President Clinton’s impeachment trial involving Monica Lewinsky alongside commentary from a Harvard professor and analysis of sexually explicit cable programming featuring nude women. The hosts then delve into discussions regarding tile placement for suggestive imagery.

topics.title: Tile, Sex Shops & Suicide
topics.summary: Scott Isaac claims tiles cause arousal due to their appearance and he’s been trained by someone else to experience this reaction. The broadcast discusses restrictions on attire at New York City strip clubs following city conflict with the sex industry, including pasties and bathing suit bottoms. A female sergeant files a lawsuit against narcotics cops for inappropriate behavior involving internet smut viewing and surveillance photos; additionally, a woman's suicide is reported after attempting contraceptive jelly as birth control.

topics.title: Movie Theater Complaints and Amsterdam Gas
topics.summary: During a radio broadcast, callers express frustration with long, dull movies and uncomfortable theater seating while discussing research indicating that breathing other people’s methane gas in Amsterdam can weaken the immune system and potentially be fatal.

topics.title: Scientists Investigate Flatulence’s Impact on Immunity
topics.summary: Researchers at the University of Amsterdam studied a sudden drop in immune function among men linked to repeated exposure to gassy coworkers or relatives. The study suggests that flatulence may weaken the immune response, potentially increasing vulnerability to diseases.

topics.title: Bathroom Incident & Adoption Dreams
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio segment, Howard and his guests discuss Jackie’s bizarre incident of chasing someone around a kitchen with his underwear while exploring Kathie Lee's desire to adopt a Chinese child from an orphanage. The conversation quickly devolves into absurd hypotheticals about the baby’s potential profession – including sweatshop work – alongside Frank’s past indiscretions, culminating in Jackie’s awkward apology for a bathtub incident.
